releaseEligibility.reason: Later ordinary-play and clean-idle diagnostics found reproducible state corruption on this exact ROM.

scope: One fresh source-authenticated Core Union stationary workload on the exact uninstrumented sandbox-polish ROM; scoped timing only.

method.view: Core Union, courier and car stationary at 560,720
method.inspection: Read-only, paused counter samples from the matching source-authenticated ROM/NOI
method.calculation: Adjacent game_time deltas modulo 256 count completed updates. Nominal rate uses 60 VBlanks per second.

comparison.limitations: These are distinct source revisions. The scoped gain does not isolate individual optimizations. The installed baseline has simpler feature content and is not a matching-fidelity comparison.

limitations: The closed timing recording passed only its scoped measurement. Later reproducible native state corruption makes this exact ROM ineligible for release, packaging or loading; the timing values remain historical observations.
One stationary Core workload does not establish repeated trials, whole-city/crowded/scrolling performance, physical smoothness or human feel.
Completed updates and nominal VBlank rate are not display FPS or exact host wall-clock throughput.
No hardware operation or cartridge loading is established by this record; installed 9c155 history remains separate.
Raw local artifacts, private paths, activation details and request tokens are omitted.
